Multi-Threaded Counter
Problem Statement:
Write a program to increment a shared counter using multiple threads. Ensure that the counter updates are synchronized to avoid race conditions.
Description:
Create a class Counter with a synchronized method increment().
Create multiple threads that call increment() multiple times.
Display the final value of the counter.
Input Format:
First line: Number of threads n
Second line: Number of increments per thread m
Output Format:
Final value of the counter
Sample Input:
3
5
Sample Output:
Final Counter: 15
